OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against (created when missing). Leave empty only for the internet scanning platforms: censys, silentpush, urlscan, cymru-scout, shodan.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time (a run sends one search at a time). The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value. Defaults to 1: Team Cymru Scout answers 1 request per second and caps the concurrent requests of an account.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

CYMRU_SCOUT_HUNT_API_KEY.description: Team Cymru Scout API key of an account with search queries.

CYMRU_SCOUT_HUNT_API_URL.description: URL of the Team Cymru Scout API.
